environment.description: NestJS microservice running in Docker container (node:18-slim) on ECS Fargate. The container runs as root with full filesystem access. The /app/public/assets directory is served via express.static() with no additional middleware. No reverse proxy in front of the application. The application binds directly to the ALB target group on port 3000. No filesystem isolation or read-only mounts configured.

config.csp_header: set by helmet in application code
